meta.title: Ch 9: Audit-Related Services — MCQ Bank
meta.description: Chapter-wise practice MCQs for Chapter 9 (Audit-Related Services).

questions.q: When the auditor reports on internal financial controls with reference to financial statements, they:
o: Express a separate audit opinion on ICFR over financial reporting (with modifications as warranted) alongside the FS opinion
Give a certificate to the stock exchange
questions.why: Under the Companies Act + framework for ICFR audit (the Indian analogue of a dual-opinion regime), the auditor's report carries a separate ICFR conclusion; an adverse ICFR conclusion goes with (or apart from) the FS opinion by its own test.
questions.trend: Repeated theme in recent ICAI exam question-patterns for this paper (AI pattern estimate — not a citation to a specific past paper question).
questions.probWhy: Realistic likelihood for Nov 2026 — two opinions, two standards of proof AI prediction, not a certainty.

mem.tip: The numbers and the plumbing get separate signatures.

questions.q: Where a statutory auditor of a company reports fraud, the reporting obligation on frauds of the notified monetary threshold is to:
o: Report to the board and wait for their judgment
Report to the Central Government in the prescribed form, without notifying the suspect/management, once satisfied an offence has occurred
File in the next audit report cycle
Report to the shareholders at the AGM
questions.why: Section 143(12) + Rules: auditors satisfying an offence involving a specified amount (5 crore or more as per notifications — check current) report to the Central Government in Form ADT-4, and must not communicate it to the (suspect) management or board in a way that defeats the purpose — the reporting-to-Audit-Committee-only practice for smaller amounts is a separate track.
questions.trend: Traceable to a real, publicly-notified amendment/standard (documented fact), tested in ICAI style.
questions.probWhy: Realistic likelihood for Nov 2026 — the silent-path rule: government first, not the accused AI prediction, not a certainty.

mem.tip: A whistle that must not be heard by the room it accuses.

questions.q: Under Indian SAs, 'dual dating' is generally:
o: Not the mechanism — the report is dated after completing procedures including subsequent events; the amended-event response is re-dating or an additional report, per the situation
questions.why: Indian practice leans on re-dating (or an additional report referring to the note) rather than the US-style dual date.
questions.trend: No dominant past-pattern signal; included for balanced coverage (AI judgement).
questions.probWhy: Lower likelihood but possible — know which dating regime you're answering Included so a low-probability surprise cannot catch you cold.

mem.tip: Sign once, or sign twice with a reason.

questions.q: The statutory reporting chain for fraud by the auditor: reported to the Central Government in the prescribed form where the fraud involves an amount of:
o: The notified threshold (Rs 5 crore and above as per the current framework; lower-value reports route to the national fraud reporting authority) — verify the operative number each attempt
questions.why: DOCUMENTED: the two-track design (government route above the notified sum; audit-committee/NFRA track for below) with the 'do not tip the suspect' mechanics is the auditable detail.
questions.trend: Traceable to a real, publicly-notified amendment/standard (documented fact), tested in ICAI style.
questions.probWhy: Realistic likelihood for Nov 2026 — threshold splits the route AI prediction, not a certainty.

mem.ti: TI: Fraud reporting — Form ADT-4 route
mem.tip: Some reports must bypass the room they describe.

questions.q: A tax audit under the Income-tax Act is principally aimed at:
o: Computing the client's total tax liability for them
Obtaining assurance that accounts are correct and tax computed per the Act, with prescribed particulars in the audit report
questions.why: Documented objectives: audit for verification of books maintained under the Act and reporting prescribed particulars to aid tax computation — the audit report supplements, never supplants, the return; exact applicability thresholds move by notification — verify for the attempt year.
questions.trend: Traceable to a real, publicly-notified amendment/standard (documented fact), tested in ICAI style.
questions.probWhy: Realistic likelihood for Nov 2026 — the auditor certifies the frame, the taxpayer files the picture AI prediction, not a certainty.

mem.tip: The tax audit hands the department a map, not the tax.

questions.q: In a stock audit for a bank, the auditor's core checks are:
o: Existence, valuation at cost/net-realisable-value (lower), hypothecation/pledge marks, aging and drawing-power against stock statements
questions.why: Drawing power (DP) computation from the stock statement — eligible classes, exclusions, aging over 9/12 months, and margin calls — is the working that ties the count to the credit line; misvalued stock is security erosion in disguise.
questions.trend: Known trap zone: ICAI objective papers repeatedly test limits/exceptions of this rule (pattern estimate).
questions.probWhy: Lower likelihood but possible — count, value, age, margin — four beats of one song Included so a low-probability surprise cannot catch you cold.

mem.tip: Stock financed by the bank answers to the bank first.

questions.q: The auditor's special responsibility on fraud in a banking company includes reporting to the principal regulator on:
o: Suspected fraud meeting the framework's criteria — per the regulator's reporting scheme ( timelines and forms prescribed)
questions.why: Bank auditors work under a specific fraud-reporting obligation to the RBI (prescribed reporting channel for accounts above notified sums, per the framework in force), alongside the general Companies Act route — the schemes co-exist and the exam answer notes both.
questions.trend: Known trap zone: ICAI objective papers repeatedly test limits/exceptions of this rule (pattern estimate).
questions.probWhy: Realistic likelihood for Nov 2026 — two reporting ladders, both climbed AI prediction, not a certainty.

mem.tip: A bank's fraud is reported twice: to the board, and to the board's board.

questions.q: An auditor's certificate under various statutes (e.g. net-worth, stock) differs from an audit because it:
o: Certifies specific facts/positions to a defined scope — the auditor verifies the matter certified, without reporting on the underlying statements
questions.why: CERTIFICATIONS are mini-attestations: the standard demands evidence and documentation for the certified fact; they are not mini-audits of everything, and liability follows the scope precisely — the wording of the certificate is the limit of the promise.
questions.trend: Core concept that appears in some avatar in most attempts under the new scheme (pattern estimate).
questions.probWhy: Realistic likelihood for Nov 2026 — a small signature is still a full standard AI prediction, not a certainty.

questions.q: Where a secretarial auditor flags non-compliance under the Companies Act, the financial auditor should:
o: Assess the compliance gaps for their accounting effect (penalties as liabilities, disqualifications affecting going concern/controls) — the two audits are parallel, not substitutive
questions.why: Compliance failures become provisions, disclosures and going-concern facts; the financial auditor uses the output as risk information (not as audit evidence on the FS) — the seam between the two regimes is exactly where hidden liabilities settle.
questions.trend: No dominant past-pattern signal; included for balanced coverage (AI judgement).
questions.probWhy: Lower likelihood but possible — compliance is the future liability's birth certificate Included so a low-probability surprise cannot catch you cold.

mem.tip: One audits the file, the other the number — the number learns from the file.
